notes.title: Update Notes - June 27 (Demo Version)
notes.content:
Hello, gamers!

I apologize for the delay in the game update.
I spent a lot of time revamping the UI to expand game content.

Here are the changes included in this update:

Update Details:

1. The main UI has been changed.
   - Added a feature to delete existing save files and start a new game.
   - Moved the character and skill purchase functions into the book.
   - Removed skill upgrades and replaced them with items.
   - Made the button to return to the pixel world more noticeable.
   - Added a shop button so you don’t have to walk to the shop in the village.

2. Fixed bugs that were suspected to cause the game to freeze.
   - Identified and fixed suspicious parts during testing.
   - Please let me know if you encounter any errors while playing.

If you encounter any issues or have feedback after the update, please feel free to leave a message on the forums. Your feedback is always welcome.

Enjoy your gaming experience!

notes.title: Update Notes - June 19 (Demo Version)
notes.content:
Hello, gamers!

Here are the changes included in this update:

Update Details:

1. Fixed the issue where the icon does not change even when the difficulty is adjusted.

2. Added village and inventory functions
   - Now the game starts inside a house in a 2D pixel village.
   - Although it is still lacking in functionality, you can walk around the village, have conversations, or explore.
   - The inventory is just a framework for now. We will update with proper items and functions within 2-3 days.
  - After pressing the menu button in the village and selecting battlefield, you can immediately enter the game.

If you encounter any issues or have feedback after the update, please feel free to leave a message on the forums. Your feedback is always welcome.

Enjoy your gaming experience!

notes.title: Patch Notes - June 17 (Demo Version)
notes.content:
Hello, gamers!

First, I want to apologize for the delay. I made a stupid mistake that caused a bug, and I spent over a day tracking it down.

Here are the changes included in this update:

Update Details:

1. Difficulty Selection Screen Changes
    - Now you can select characters and difficulty all from the current difficulty selection screen.
    - Character purchases are still available in the previous menu for now, but they will be moved soon.
    - With the introduction of the inventory, the skill shop will be changed to the item shop.

2. Added Particle Transparency Adjustment for Explosion Effects
    - Some intense flash effects don't show much difference with transparency adjustments, but they still look okay, so I've left them as is.
    - If you still find the effects visually obstructive, please let me know. I will fix them.

Other features will be completed and shown soon.

Thank you to all the users who enjoyed the game during the Next Fest period. Your continued interest and feedback are greatly appreciated.

Thank you.

notes.title: Patch Notes - June 15 (Demo Version)
notes.content:
Hello, gamers!

Here are the changes included in this update:

Update Details:

1. Fixed the issue where the machine gun cat's mouse click wasn't working.
2. Updated the skill icon at the top of the screen:
    - Modified it so that when weapon unlock conditions are met, lamps now appear in the weapon and support skill slots.
3. Added a new feature where chicks randomly come out of boxes:
    - Chicks will lift enemies into the air for 8 seconds.
4. Fixed the issue where the game over occurred when only two enemies remained.

Upcoming Changes:

1. Frame rate drop issue:
    - There's a problem where the frame rate drops significantly when there are a lot of souls and gems from enemies. I'll fix this soon.

2. Transparency adjustment feature for effects:
    - Planning to add a feature to adjust the transparency of effects to enhance visibility.
    - Thanks to PuddlePirate for the suggestion.

3. Adding item Inventory:
    - Currently working on adding inventory to obtain items and equip them by parts.

If you encounter any issues or have feedback after the update, please feel free to leave a message on the forums. Your feedback is always welcome.

Enjoy your gaming experience!

notes.title: Patch Notes - June 13 (Demo Version)
notes.content:
Hello, gamers!

Here are the changes included in this update:

Update Details:

1. Special Card Condition Display: Conditions for obtaining the special card for each skill are now displayed in the game.
2. Redraw Count Adjustment: The initial redraw count has been set to 3.
3. UI Fix: Fixed the issue where the skill icon UI was misaligned on the Steam Deck.
4. Game Over Issue Fix: Resolved the issue where the character would keep walking in the last input direction after game over.
5. Camera Adjustments:
    - Adjusted the angle of Camera 4.
    - Fixed the issue where enemies would sink below the ground on Camera 4.
6. Spin Charge Crash Fix: Fixed the crash issue occurring when obtaining the Spin Charge.
7. Character Speed Issue: Fixed the issue where the initial character speed was not increased as mentioned in the previous notice.
8. Game Clear Issue Fix: In cases where the game does not clear even after killing all enemies, the game will now automatically clear by eliminating any remaining enemies.
    - If you still encounter issues, please post on the forum.
    - Thanks to Meophist for reporting this issue.
9. Item Box Change: Item boxes that appear every minute will now drop multiple random items.
10. The potion's effect has been increased threefold.
11. Enemy Wave Adjustment: Adjusted enemy spawns to make them appear more smoothly and continuously.


Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Minor bug fix on 6/12
notes.content:
I have fixed the bug that caused the game to crash when purchasing the dash skill from the shop.

In the current version, dash is a default skill, so there is no need to purchase it separately. 

In future updates, I will remove the dash purchase feature and replace it with another skill.

Thank you,
Lee.

notes.title: Patch Notes - June 12 (Demo Version)
notes.content:
Hi,

The tutorial has been removed.

Character health has been increased by approximately 3 times.
Character speed has been increased by 40%.

Attack power has been slightly increased.

The number of attack skills obtainable is now limited to a maximum of 5.
However, more stacking is allowed, and all special skills obtainable at level 9 have been unlocked.

Quest conditions have not been modified yet, so unlock notifications will still appear as conditions are met.

The amount of gems obtainable has been significantly increased.

Currently, skill combinations required to obtain special skills are not displayed in the game.
This will be updated along with other features by tomorrow.

Thank you,
Lee.
